findings.title: Administrative web interface is reachable
findings.evidence: HTTP and HTTPS responses include the title Mirth Connect Administrator.
findings.remediation: Restrict the administrative interface to trusted networks or a VPN and require strong authentication.

findings.title: Potentially risky HTTP method enabled
findings.evidence: The http-methods script reports TRACE as a potentially risky method.
findings.remediation: Disable TRACE unless explicitly required by the application.

findings.title: SSH is exposed
findings.evidence: Port 22/tcp is open and identified as OpenSSH 9.2p1 Debian 2+deb12u7.
findings.remediation: Limit SSH access to trusted sources and enforce key-based authentication.
